Perfect! Now let me create a comprehensive summary. Let me compile all the information I've gathered:

## Comprehensive Frontend Analysis Report

Based on my thorough exploration of the frontend files in `/Users/brunobrunkow/Downloads/SmarterPlaylists-master/app/web/`, here's a complete breakdown:

---

### 1. OAUTH/LOGIN FLOW: index.html → auth.html → callback.html → go.html

**Flow Sequence:**

1. **index.html** - Entry point/landing page
   - Checks if `sp-auth-code` exists in localStorage (line 101-107)
   - If auth code exists: redirects to `go.html`
   - If no auth code: shows login button
   - Calls `loginWithSpotifyForAuth()` from main.js on login button click

2. **auth.html** - OAuth redirect target
   - Receives OAuth code from Spotify via URL parameters
   - Stores code in localStorage as `sp-auth-code` (line 65)
   - Redirects to `go.html` after 100ms delay (line 68)
   - Handles errors from Spotify (line 70-73)

3. **callback.html** - Legacy direct playlist saver (not part of main auth flow)
   - Used for creating/updating Spotify playlists directly
   - Parses hash parameters for `access_token` and `code`
   - Makes direct Spotify API calls to create/update playlists
   - Shows progress during track addition

4. **go.html** - Main authenticated application (Raphael/Graffle UI)
   - Loads after authentication is complete
   - Requires valid `sp-auth-code` from localStorage
   - Initializes editor, inventory loading, and program directory
   - Uses main.js for authentication and API interactions

5. **go2.html** - Alternative main app (Joint.js UI - newer version)
   - Modern replacement for go.html with different visualization
   - Uses main2.js instead of main.js
   - Same authentication flow

---

### 2. AUTH TOKEN STORAGE & PASSING

**localStorage Keys:**
- `sp-auth-code` - Spotify authorization code (string)
- `sp-maintenance` - Maintenance mode key
- `motd-count` - Message of the day counter
- `playlist-title` - Title of playlist being created
- `playlist-tids` - Track IDs JSON array
- `playlist-uri` - Spotify URI of playlist
- `playlist-save-status` - Status of last save operation (JSON)
- `sp-last-run` - Timestamp of last program run

**Auth Code Usage:**
- Retrieved via `get_auth_code()` function in main.js (line 22-25)
- Cleared via `clear_auth_code()` function (line 27-29)
- Passed as `auth_code` parameter in ALL backend API calls

**Token Flow:**
1. User logs in → Redirected to Spotify
2. Spotify redirects to `auth_redirect_uri` (auth.html or callback.html)
3. Code stored in localStorage
4. Frontend passes code with every API request to backend
5. Backend exchanges code for access token (not stored in frontend)

---

### 3. ALL API CALLS FROM JAVASCRIPT

**Backend API Base Path:**
- Local: `http://localhost:5000/SmarterPlaylists/`
- Remote: `/SmarterPlaylists/`
- Selected based on `isLocalHost()` function

**All API Endpoints Called:**

From **main.js/main2.js**:
- `GET /config` - Fetch client_id for OAuth
- `GET /inventory` - Get available components
- `GET /system-status` - Get system status and maintenance info
- `GET /schedule_status` - Get schedule status for a program

From **program.js**:
- `GET /program` - Load program by PID (params: `auth_code`, `pid`)
- `GET /shared` - Load shared program without auth (params: `pid`)
- `GET /shared_info` - Load shared program info (params: `auth_code`, `pid`)
- `GET /directory` - Load user's program directory (params: `auth_code`, `count`)
- `GET /imports` - Load importable programs (params: `auth_code`, `count`)
- `GET /examples` - Load example programs (params: `auth_code`)
- `POST /save` - Save program (data: `program`, `auth_code`)
- `POST /run` - Run program (data: `pid`, `save`, `auth_code`)
- `POST /schedule` - Schedule program (data: `pid`, `when`, `delta`, `total`, `auth_code`)
- `POST /delete` - Delete program (data: `pid`, `auth_code`)
- `POST /copy` - Copy program (data: `pid`, `auth_code`)
- `POST /import` - Import shared program (data: `pid`, `auth_code`)
- `POST /publish` - Publish/share program (data: `pid`, `share`, `auth_code`)

From **callback.html** (direct Spotify API calls):
- `GET https://api.spotify.com/v1/me` - Get current user info (header: `Authorization: Bearer`)
- `POST https://api.spotify.com/v1/users/{username}/playlists` - Create playlist
- `POST https://api.spotify.com/v1/users/{username}/playlists/{pid}/tracks` - Add tracks
- `PUT https://api.spotify.com/v1/users/{username}/playlists/{pid}/tracks` - Replace tracks

From **playlist.js**:
- `GET https://api.spotify.com/v1/tracks/{track_id}` - Fetch track info (for preview URL)

---

### 4. CALLBACK.HTML & AUTH.HTML OAUTH HANDLING DETAILS

**auth.html** (lines 59-83):
```
- Parses URL for 'code' parameter (OAuth authorization code)
- Stores in localStorage['sp-auth-code']
- On error: displays error message
- Redirects to go.html after receiving code
```

**callback.html** (lines 158-210):
```
- Parses location.hash for access_token or code
- Stores token in global g_access_token
- Fetches username via /v1/me endpoint
- Creates new playlist
- Adds tracks to playlist in batches of 100
- Shows progress and success/error messages
- Stores save status in localStorage['playlist-save-status']
```

**OAuth Redirect URIs:**
- Local auth: `http://localhost:8000/auth.html`
- Remote auth: `{window.location.origin}/auth.html`
- Local callback: `http://localhost:8000/callback.html`
- Remote callback: `{window.location.origin}/callback.html`

---

### 5. HARDCODED SPOTIFY-RELATED VALUES

**Scopes** (from main.js, lines 435-441):
```javascript
"playlist-read-private"
"playlist-read-collaborative"
"playlist-modify-public"
"playlist-modify-private"
"user-library-read"
"user-follow-read"
"user-top-read"
```

**Spotify API Endpoints:**
- Auth: `https://accounts.spotify.com/authorize`
- API: `https://api.spotify.com/v1/`

**Client ID:**
- NOT hardcoded
- Fetched from `/config` endpoint at runtime

---

### 6. HTML PAGES AND THEIR JAVASCRIPT DEPENDENCIES

**main.js Usage** (13 pages):
- index.html - Login/landing
- auth.html - OAuth callback handler
- about.html - About page
- examples.html - Example programs gallery
- go.html - Main editor (v1 - Raphael/Graffle)
- importer.html - Program import dialog
- imports.html - Import/discovery page
- info.html - Info page
- maintenance.html - Maintenance page
- schedule.html - Schedule program
- viewer.html - View shared program

**main2.js Usage** (1 page):
- go2.html - Main editor v2 (Joint.js - newer UI)

**callback.html** (0 references - standalone):
- Self-contained, no main.js or main2.js

**All pages also load:**
- program.js - Program model and API layer
- editor.js (for edit pages) - Visual editor
- editor2.js (for go2.html) - Editor v2
- playlist.js - Playlist display and Spotify preview
- Supporting libs: jQuery, Bootstrap, Underscore/Lodash, Raphael (or Joint.js)

---

### 7. FILE MANIFEST WITH ROLES

**Authentication & Core Logic:**
- `/Users/brunobrunkow/Downloads/SmarterPlaylists-master/app/web/main.js` - OAuth login, config, auth code management
- `/Users/brunobrunkow/Downloads/SmarterPlaylists-master/app/web/main2.js` - Identical to main.js (alternate version)

**Program Model & API:**
- `/Users/brunobrunkow/Downloads/SmarterPlaylists-master/app/web/program.js` - Program CRUD, all backend API calls, component management

**Visual Editors:**
- `/Users/brunobrunkow/Downloads/SmarterPlaylists-master/app/web/editor.js` - Raphael-based visual graph editor
- `/Users/brunobrunkow/Downloads/SmarterPlaylists-master/app/web/editor2.js` - Joint.js-based visual graph editor

**Playlist Display:**
- `/Users/brunobrunkow/Downloads/SmarterPlaylists-master/app/web/playlist.js` - Track display and Spotify preview playback

**HTML Entry Points:**
- `/Users/brunobrunkow/Downloads/SmarterPlaylists-master/app/web/index.html` - Landing/login page
- `/Users/brunobrunkow/Downloads/SmarterPlaylists-master/app/web/auth.html` - OAuth code receiver
- `/Users/brunobrunkow/Downloads/SmarterPlaylists-master/app/web/callback.html` - Direct Spotify playlist creator
- `/Users/brunobrunkow/Downloads/SmarterPlaylists-master/app/web/go.html` - Main app (v1 editor)
- `/Users/brunobrunkow/Downloads/SmarterPlaylists-master/app/web/go2.html` - Main app (v2 editor)
- `/Users/brunobrunkow/Downloads/SmarterPlaylists-master/app/web/importer.html` - Import shared programs
- `/Users/brunobrunkow/Downloads/SmarterPlaylists-master/app/web/imports.html` - Import/discovery list
- `/Users/brunobrunkow/Downloads/SmarterPlaylists-master/app/web/examples.html` - Public examples
- `/Users/brunobrunkow/Downloads/SmarterPlaylists-master/app/web/viewer.html` - View shared programs
- `/Users/brunobrunkow/Downloads/SmarterPlaylists-master/app/web/schedule.html` - Schedule programs
- `/Users/brunobrunkow/Downloads/SmarterPlaylists-master/app/web/about.html` - About page
- `/Users/brunobrunkow/Downloads/SmarterPlaylists-master/app/web/info.html` - Info page
- `/Users/brunobrunkow/Downloads/SmarterPlaylists-master/app/web/maintenance.html` - Maintenance notice

---

### KEY SECURITY OBSERVATIONS

1. **Auth Code Flow:** Uses authorization code flow (secure), not implicit grant
2. **Token Storage:** Auth code stored in localStorage (frontend never gets access token)
3. **Backend Token Exchange:** Backend responsible for exchanging code for token (not shown in frontend)
4. **Session Check:** `checkForBadUser()` detects invalid auth and redirects to login
5. **API Parameter:** Auth code passed with every API call as `auth_code` parameter

This architecture separates concerns: frontend handles UI/auth code, backend handles token exchange and Spotify API calls.
